lead.topic: Dune: Part Two: the black-and-white arena was shot on an infrared camera
lead.point: Dune Part Two's black-and-white Giedi Prime scenes were not graded grey later: Greig Fraser shot them on a camera that sees only infrared light.
lead.insight: Villeneuve imagined Giedi Prime's sun giving no colour. Fraser swapped the camera's infrared-blocking filter for an 87C filter that blocks visible light, so the camera records only infrared. Black can turn white on that camera, so some costumes were made twice. That is why the arena feels like another planet.
